description: THE PRIMARY STANDOUT WORKFLOW. Use this when a user wants an AI-built website made client-ready without choosing individual design tools. First call: pass url (best), source, or business. Standout captures the baseline, scores the real phone and desktop render, chooses a coherent direction, and returns the exact implementation contract for the coding agent. The agent MUST apply the fixes in the repository. Final call: pass the baseline report link returned by the first call as url (or the original url if the old version is still live at its own address), plus after_url/after_source for the improved page. If the live site was changed in place, after_url is that same live address. Standout compares the saved baseline with the improved page and produces a client-safe before-and-after report and share link. Do not stop after returning advice; the completed outcome is fix, rerender, prove.

after_source.description: Improved page source for proof mode when there is no public preview URL.

after_url.description: Improved public page URL. Supplying this switches the workflow to proof mode and compares before vs after. If the live site was improved in place, this is the same address that was first audited.

agency_name.description: Optional agency/studio name for the final client proof report.

business.description: What the business is and what the page sells.

reference.description: Optional approved reference URL or curated reference id.

source.description: Original/current HTML, CSS, JSX, or TSX when the page is not public.

url.description: First call: the current public page URL (best input, it enables live phone and desktop rendering). Final call: the baseline report link the first call returned, or the original page URL if the old version is still live.

vibe.description: Optional visual steer, e.g. premium, light, editorial, technical.

name: polish_and_prove
